form: Step ids look like step-12. Use null for a value the material does not give.

questions.text: Why did the approach change, and at which step?

fields.new_plan: the step id of the plan that replaced an earlier plan
fields.replaced_plan: the step id of the plan it replaced
fields.trigger: the step id of the observation that caused the change
fields.measure: the name of the measure that missed what was expected of it
fields.measured: the value that was measured, a number
fields.threshold: the value it was expected to reach, a number

questions.text: Which code and parameters produced the final result?

fields.run: the step id of the run that produced the final result
fields.command: the command of that run, as it was given
fields.code: the commit of the code that run used
fields.parameters: the parameters given to that command, as an object of names and values; {} when none were given

questions.text: How many attempts did the final plan take before it held?

fields.plan: the step id of the final plan
fields.measured_runs: how many measured runs that plan took, up to and including the first that met its expectations, a number

fields.abandoned: a list with one object for each plan or analysis that was tried and given up: {"what": a few words, "step": the step id of the plan, "result": the measured number that ended it}
